presets.name: Default
presets.summary: A neutral 66-book preset with no tradition-specific framings. Starting point for forks that will supply their own presets.

note: Fork this file and the per-preset JSONs beside it to supply tradition-specific framings. The kernel ships only the neutral default; richer presets (Protestant, Catholic, Orthodox, Historical Protestant, Anabaptist, Jehovah's Witnesses, etc.) are the responsibility of the downstream application that offers them.
